title: Canada’s beloved Tim Hortons brews ire over ‘excessive’ Israeli data deal
text:
NewsFeed

Canada’s beloved Tim Hortons brews ire over ‘excessive’ Israeli data deal

Advocates raised concerns about the Tim Horton’s app and consumer privacy and data-sharing, involving a firm with ties to Israel’s military. Al Jazeera’s Urooba Jamal reports.
